text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Palmer and Daitaku Helios engaged 
in a fierce duel for the lead on the long 
final straight of the Tenno Sho (Autumn), 
sending the crowd into absolute frenzy.

The final battle for the Best Friends duo 
is the Arima Kinen. Mejiro Palmer decides 
to throw everything she discovered by 
constantly running away from the Mejiro 
name into the race.
